description: Research sources: one row per manifest row, every column raw.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Paper id: arXiv id, else DOI, else url: and a hash of the URL.

columns.name: row
columns.description: Row number in the manifest, from 1 (the header is not a row).

columns.name: research
columns.description: Research report the source was gathered for.

columns.name: topic
columns.description: Topic folder of the source.

columns.name: also_in
columns.description: Other topics that cite the source, ;-joined (may be empty).

columns.name: type
columns.description: Source type: paper or web.

columns.name: title
columns.description: Source title.

columns.name: authors
columns.description: Comma-separated author list as the manifest gives it.

columns.name: year
columns.description: Publication year (empty in the manifest: null).

columns.name: venue
columns.description: Venue as the manifest gives it, e.g. arXiv preprint.

columns.name: url
columns.description: Landing page URL.

columns.name: pdf_url
columns.description: PDF URL (may be empty).

columns.name: arxiv_id
columns.description: arXiv identifier (may be empty).

columns.name: doi
columns.description: DOI (may be empty).

columns.name: license
columns.description: Licence of the source as the manifest gives it.

columns.name: status
columns.description: Download status, e.g. downloaded or no_pdf_link.

columns.name: local_file
columns.description: Repository-relative PDF path when downloaded.

columns.name: relevance
columns.description: One-sentence note on why the source matters.

columns.name: also_in_list
columns.description: also_in split on ; into topics.

columns.name: venue_id
columns.description: Entity id of the venue (SHA-256 of its normalisation key).

columns.name: licence_id
columns.description: Entity id of the licence (SHA-256 of its normalisation key).
